theorem_natural_language_statement:
Suppose a stored pair at a chosen slot contains bounded natural codes $i,j$, with positive original count $N$ and valid output code $j<\operatorname{localCount}(h)^J$. Assume the exact layer-mask table, helper placement, protected input/output separation, space and word envelopes, and call depth. The wanted decoder returns the occurrence-only code, writes the full decoded record for $i,j$, and preserves memory below its output base, within its stated time.

This decoder makes an emitted physical wanted slot usable by the original-owner and retained-source access routines.
